versions.changelog:
- Initial release: Log, track, and analyze running workouts.
- Supports intuitive input (distance, time, date) in casual formats.
- Automatically calculates pace, speed, and calories burned for each run.
- Provides personalized progress notes after each run (e.g. trends, personal bests, encouragement).
- Answers running history questions, including bests, averages, trends, and projections.
